Ravi (CS): Quick: EmberPay renewal demo in 6 days. They want a one-pager customers can follow for demo day (warmup, cache, fallback, short survey). Can eng/sre/solutions give bullet steps we can email?

Olga (Eng): Keep it customer-friendly: 1) Prefill ~50 frequent prompts 10-15m before the demo to seed KV cache. 2) Start a transient warm pool sized for concurrency. 3) Enable fallback routing to a quantized model. Sample prefill curl for them: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"tenant_id":"emberpay-prod","prompts":["account balance","recent charges"]}'
```

Ravi (CS): They plan ~90 concurrent demo connections. Any guidance on warm_pool/batch sizes? :thinking_face:

Hector (SRE): For 90 concurrent: warm_pool 4 per shard, batch_target 6. Temporary alerts: queue_depth > 35 or p95_latency > 700ms during demo window. Bump autoscale max to +50% for 30m. If fallback triggers, route 5% traffic to primary to monitor quality.

Maya (Solutions): I'll run a 20-min smoke 24h before and collect 5 sample prompts per demo path. Post-demo survey (2 quick Qs) we can embed: 1) Latency OK? (Yes/No). 2) Any output issues? (optional). We'll attach responses to the renewal ticket.

deploy-bot: deployment: warm-pool-adjust -> canary (id: c-7751). ETA 90s.

Olga (Eng): Note for runbook: add fallback rollback step (reduce fallback % if outputs degrade) and a short troubleshooting checklist for customers: restart demo app, clear client cache, confirm prefill ran.

Ravi (CS): Action items: @Olga add prefill snippet to one-pager; @Hector add temporary alerts + autoscale bump; @Maya run smoke + send survey link. I'll confirm demo times with EmberPay PM and mark renewal risk = Monitor.

Hector (SRE): Staging quick check: KV hit rate improved from 4% -> 69% after prefill. Cached requests p95 ~115ms. I'll standby during demo.

Ravi (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread after the smoke and attach survey + perf summary to the renewal ticket. :)
